description: Per-run keyword-position-distribution buckets for a tracker, oldest first — how many tracked keywords sit in the top 3, 4-10, 11-20, or outside the top 20, per check run. Use it to answer 'is this domain's visibility trending up or down' without re-checking anything. FREE: database only. No SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. Buckets are disjoint and cover every tracked keyword: `notRanking` is derived as the remainder, not fetched separately, and `top3 + top4to10 + top11to20 + notRanking` always equals the tracker's keyword count at that run. `device` is accepted but on every free SERP source today it narrows nothing — see get_rank_tracker's own note on this deployment's device support.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

device.description: Which device's positions to bucket. On every free SERP source today this narrows nothing — there is no device dimension, so every reading folds to one series regardless of what is passed. Defaults to desktop.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

sinceDays.description: How many days back to look, 1–730. Defaults to 365.

name: get_rank_config_trend
